title: Walking Dead — Gladiator level
summary: From 7 games where all six players were Gladiators (26 Sep, 4 won). Fear their healer into Army and Zenith. They beat us by CC on our Priest at the kill.

evidence.note: 26 Sep 2026 · 4 won, 3 lost · every player a Gladiator

sections.title: Fear their healer, then go
sections.body: All 6 of our goes that led to a kill had Psychic Scream on their healer; 6 of the other 10 did. The DK and Monk usually burst together; it killed when their healer was locked out or kicked during those 6 seconds. We killed a Ret twice, an Elemental and an Unholy DK. Touch of Death finished 2 of the 4. Seven games is a start: a proposal to correct.

sections.title: Main go: crowd control on their healer, on top of the burst

steps.note: On their healer during the burst. Locked or kicked then: 3 of 5 killed; free: 1 of 7.
Onto their healer as the fear ends. The 20:19 kill: healer stunned as the DK died.
Or kick their healer inside the burst: 2 of the 6 goes that killed.
With Dark Transformation: the DK's half of every kill.
Pressed in all 6 goes that killed.
The Monk's half. In all 6 goes that killed.
The finish at 3-9% health. 2 of the 4 kills.

sections.title: Hold the trinket for their kill, and do not stack on the DK

steps.note: For the CC that comes with their cooldowns. Already used in 2 of 3 losses.
Not on top of Icebound or Lichborne: stacked 5 times in 3 losses, 3 in 4 wins.
The DK's own big one. Pain Suppression on top of it was the usual overlap.

sections.title: What beat us: answers on time, CC on our Priest at the kill
sections.body: In the 3 losses the enemy spent more defensives per go than the teams we beat (4.6 against 3.2), and none of our goes led to a kill. Every kill on us came with our Priest locked out: Garrote, Strangulate, Silence. We lost to Resto Druid/Affliction/Assassination, Resto Druid/Unholy/BM (1-1 in a rematch) and Resto Shaman/Shadow Priest/Affliction.
